reason: The hypothesis directly mirrors the findings of E2, E4, and E5, which demonstrate the hot ductility drop, the method to induce serrated boundaries, the strain redistribution mechanism, and the quantitative improvements in ductility and creep life. premises: SLM-fabricated single-phase HEA exhibits hot ductility drop due to intergranular fracture along straight grain boundaries
Serrated grain boundaries can be induced by reduced cooling rate after solution treatment, via precipitate coarsening
Serrated boundaries distribute strain more evenly and reduce strain concentration at triple junctions
Serrated boundaries significantly increase tensile fracture strain and creep rupture life at 650°C
The mechanism is morphological (strain redistribution) rather than segregation or precipitation
